Lập phiếu xuất kho cho hao hụt chuyển kh: Create stock issues for transfer shortages
Hàng thiếu, hỏng khi nhận chuyển kho, đã: Items were short or damaged when the transfer was received and were written off the in-transit warehouse when the delivery report was approved. Create a stock issue from this warehouse. Make-up delivery: the sending warehouse ships the items again on a new transfer, which goes to AMIS in the batch that contains it. Write off shortage: the items are lost for good; charge them to whoever is responsible or expense them, based on the reason.
Lập phiếu xuất kho cho đơn hủy không về: Create stock issues for canceled orders whose items never came back
Đơn đã hủy nên không ghi doanh thu, nhưn: The order was canceled so no revenue is recorded, but there's no return receipt: the items left the warehouse and never came back. Create an other stock issue to reduce stock in AMIS; if the items come back later, skip this step.
Kiểm lại đơn hủy nhập lại lệch số lượng: Check canceled orders returned with a different quantity
Số nhập lại kho khác số đã xuất. Nhập tr: The quantity received back differs from the quantity issued. If it was received twice, ask the warehouse to fix the receipt; if there really is extra, create an other stock receipt for it; if some is missing, create an other stock issue for it.

Không tìm thấy phiếu xuất của đơn trong: The order's stock issue isn't in this batch. Chứng từ Hàng bán trả lại trong lô chỉ g: The sales return in this batch only reduces receivables and has no stock receipt. When the items are back in stock, create a stock receipt of type "Sales return receipt"; if the customer had paid, create a payment voucher when refunding.

Đơn tại quầy khách trả bằng nhiều cách,: The customer paid at the counter using more than one method, so the sale goes to AMIS as "Not yet collected" (accounts receivable). Create a receipt for each payment method to clear the receivable.

"2/14" means 2 returns out of 14 orders sold on the channel.

Tiền hàng của các đơn đã xuất đủ hàng tr: Merchandise value of orders fully shipped in the period (in-store sales count at checkout), all channels, after discounts. Excludes VAT and shipping fees; marketplace orders don't record VAT, so their merchandise value is used as is. Customer returns and marketplace returns are deducted on the day the goods come back, so past periods don't change. {{kho}}.
Doanh thu trừ giá vốn của hàng đã bán (g: Revenue minus the cost of goods sold (purchase cost of each lot). Returned goods that can be resold add their cost back; defective returns don't. Marketplace fees, shipping, wages and rent are not deducted.
Hàng trả lỗi {{tien}} giá vốn không cộng: Defective returns at {{tien}} cost are not added back.
Biên lãi {{bien}}: cứ 100.000 ₫ bán ra t: Margin {{bien}}: every 100.000 ₫ sold earns {{lai}} ₫ gross profit.
Số đơn đã xuất đủ hàng trong kỳ (đơn tại: Orders fully shipped in the period (in-store sales count at checkout). Orders returned in full by the customer or the marketplace are deducted in the period of the return, like revenue, so past periods don't shrink. Cancelled orders don't count.

Doanh thu hoặc số đơn kỳ này chưa dương: Revenue or orders this period aren't positive yet, so there's no average.

Số cái đã đặt nhà cung cấp trong đơn mua: Units ordered from suppliers on purchase orders that haven't arrived. Goods that arrived and are waiting to be counted are in To do.
Số cái đã xuất khỏi kho gửi trong phiếu: Units shipped out on transfers that the receiving warehouse hasn't finished receiving.
Số cái đang trên đường đến kho này và từ: Units on the way to and from this warehouse on shipped transfers that haven't been fully received.
Mỗi mã hàng ở mỗi kho tính một dòng. Tồn: Each SKU in each warehouse counts as one line. The minimum stock comes from, in order: the level set for the SKU in that warehouse, the level set for the product, then the default ({{nguong}} units). Overstock means sellable units exceed 1.5 times the minimum stock, as in the inventory report.
Sắp hết: còn ≤ tồn tối thiểu: Low: at or below minimum stock

Số cái ít nhất nên có sẵn ở kho này. Còn: The fewest units this warehouse should keep. At or below this level counts as Low. Taken from, in order: the level set for the SKU in this warehouse, the level set for the product, then the default ({{nguong}} units).
Số cái của mã này trong đơn mua chưa về: Units of this SKU on purchase orders not yet received at the central warehouse. 0 means nothing is on order; create a purchase order.
Số cái có thể bán của mã này ở Kho tổng,: Sellable units of this SKU at the central warehouse, i.e. what can be transferred to the store right away. If the central warehouse is out too, order from a supplier.
